data.body:
Patch set 3 (LLM-Review passed +1 on ps2 with 7 advisories): fixed one genuine bug from the advisories and closed a test gap.

FIXED (concurrency bug): the backgrounded graceful-retire subshell inherited the deploy flock FD (9) and held it for up to MCP_STOP_GRACE (1260s) after the tick exited, so every subsequent autodeploy tick (ANY component) would skip with 'another deploy holds the lock' — wedging the whole timer for ~21 min after any mcp retire. Now closes FD 9 in the subshell (exec 9>&-). RED-first test test_backgrounded_retire_does_not_hold_the_deploy_lock (docker stub records stop-fd9-leaked iff FD 9 open at docker stop).

FIXED (test gap): added test_over_cap_managed_set_emits_retire_cap_without_forcing covering the over-cap branch of mcp_retire_sweep (reason 'over-cap', distinct from the already-tested 'port-exhausted' path), asserting no force-kill.

DEFERRED remaining ps2 advisories (all spec-acknowledged tradeoffs or benign): --restart-always reboot resurrection (spec-mandated compose parity; exited containers reaped each tick); docker compose build re-tagging compose-mcp:latest (the ticket's build mechanism; blue-green containers pin the immutable :<sha> tag, not :latest); /health being auth-independent (explicitly documented in the plan — the compose-parity oracle is the auth-drift guard); flip backup cp||true when the include is absent (the include is always seeded by materialize-mcp-upstream.sh; rollback-to-absent == remove is correct); inspect-failure classified as exited (docker rm refuses a running container, so no live container is removed).
